QuestionStmt.S: Calculate the enthalpy of vaporisation of ethanol if 11.5 g of ethanol is completely vaporised by supplying 11.8 kJ of heat.

Solution.S:
Given: mass of ethanol m = 11.5 g, heat supplied q = 11.8 kJ, molar mass of ethanol (C₂H₅OH) = 46 g/mol.

Moles of ethanol = 11.5 / 46 = 0.25 mol.

Enthalpy of vaporisation per mole = q / n = 11.8 / 0.25 = 47.2 kJ/mol.

Thus the correct option is B: 47.2 kJ mol⁻¹.
